description: Sibling finding to fz-bkx (surfaced by the 2026-07-04 concordant-fold survey). FrontDoorError { msg: String, span: Span } (src/compiler2/frontdoor.rs:18) has From<QuotedSourceError> (frontdoor.rs:39-43) that drops the DiagCode AND discards the real span (substitutes Span::DUMMY) -- the same 'lossy From erases user/internal classification + diagnostic code' smell as fz-bkx, but in the frontdoor/lexer domain. NOT a type-fold (FrontDoorError carries a span QuotedFunctionError doesn't, so it's not a duplicate type) -- it's a diagnostic-fidelity bug: user errors lose their code and span through this boundary. FIX: preserve DiagCode and the source span when converting QuotedSourceError at the frontdoor. Single call-site problem. Relate to fz-bkx (do fz-bkx first; this may share the resolution pattern).

comments.text:
First attempt (commit cd954dd68) DISCARDED after adversarial audit found two blockers + a wrong-target finding:

1. DiagCode half is DEAD in frontdoor: frontdoor.rs never mints a coded (::user) QuotedSourceError — all its QuotedSourceError ?-conversions guard QuotedSourceBuilder calls that fail only via ::new / ::from(AnyValueRefError) (internal heap-validity). ::user lives only in quoted_function/quoted_surface/quoted_expander, which frontdoor doesn't call. So the added FrontDoorError.code field is always None here.
2. Span half fixed WRONG: the mechanical .at(self.cur_span()) at ~111 sites used cur_span()=self.toks[self.pos].span = the NEXT unconsumed token (one past the failed construct); ~87/111 had a correct in-scope span/start one line away. Degrades ~111 spans to off-by-one; only ~40 hand-fixed sites correct. 578 lines for ~40 correct spans + ~111 worse spans + 0 DiagCode value.

WRONG TARGET: frontdoor's conversions are INTERNAL builder failures (real user parse errors go through FrontDoorError::syntax(msg,span), already spanned, only 3 sites) — precise spans there are low-value. The REAL user-facing dummy-span is emit_surface_read_error (quoted_expander.rs:711): user CODED errors from quoted_function decode (e.g. fz-go4.49's PARSE_BITSTRING_BAD_MODIFIER, fz-bkx's codes) render with Span::DUMMY, losing location. But QuotedSourceError carries NO span (only message+code).

RE-SCOPE (pending user confirm): thread the offending AST node's span (__fz_span__ metadata) at the ~10 ::user raise sites in quoted_function, add a span to QuotedSourceError, and have emit_surface_read_error use it instead of Span::DUMMY. Smaller + surgical + fixes the spans users actually see. Leave frontdoor's internal-failure spans alone. AtSpan/from_quoted machinery from the discarded attempt was sound but misapplied.

DONE (folded to 159d7d590). RE-SCOPED + reworked after the first attempt (cd954dd68) was discarded for targeting the wrong file. Correct fix: QuotedSourceError gained span: Option<Span> (new/From=None for internal builder/heap failures; user(code,span,msg) dummy-filtered); 21 ::user raise sites in quoted_function/quoted_surface thread the offending node's real span from __fz_span__ meta; emit_surface_read_error (quoted_expander.rs) renders error.span().unwrap_or(DUMMY) for coded user errors. frontdoor.rs UNTOUCHED (its conversions are internal builder failures; DUMMY fine there); no code field added to FrontDoorError.

Audit (adversarial) then a fix pass: F2 fixed — call-shaped size(...)/unit(...)/name modifiers now use the tight node_span (matching the fn's own doc), bare literals keep field_span (frontdoor quotes literals without span meta); F1 fixed — float-modifier test tightened with an upper bound (catches over-wide spans); new PARSE_BITSTRING_BAD_SIZE coverage (00557, <<1::size(1.5)>>) asserting the span EQUALS size(1.5). Also fixed a latent SourceId(0) placeholder for the @spec-fragment path via FragmentCursor::current_span rebuild.

lib 1234/0/9, clippy clean, single-threaded fixture 19-by-name. 299+/33-, 6 files.

FOLLOW-UP FILED fz-3sb (P2): the SourceId(0) placeholder in token_payload::decode_token still leaks into @type/type-ascription/map diagnostics (RESOLVE_TYPE_ALIAS) — wrong file in multi-file compiles; masked today because all fixtures are single-file. Fix at decode_token source (obsoletes the FragmentCursor rebuild) or at type_expr.rs.

title: FrontDoorError's From<QuotedSourceError> drops DiagCode and real span (Span::DUMMY) -- same lossy-classification bug as fz-bkx, frontdoor domain
